profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer specializing in iOS development. Expert in implementing scalable digital experiences and engineering high-quality mobile solutions. Passionate about innovation, mentorship, and fostering collaborative environments to drive impactful projects. Dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
National Big-Box Warehouse Retail Client

─ Spearheaded the development of key micro-services ("Warehouse", "Shop", "Digital Membership") using Swift package framework.
─ Acted as the iOS liaison between offshore and client development teams, ensuring seamless communication and feature delivery.
─ Utilized Firebase crashlytics to debug high-priority defects.
─ Improved code quality by addressing technical debt, implementing unit tests, and replacing Objective-C in favor of Swift/SwiftUI.

National Recreational Equipment Retail Client

─ Developed a "Bulletin" feature to improve internal communication and customer service within their employee empowerment tool.
─ Refactored the entire codebase to remove Objective-C in favor of Swift/UIKit, enhancing maintainability and performance.
─ Collaborated with QA engineers to implement automated testing and tackled technical debt to improve overall codebase quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer L2
positions.description:
National Home Improvement Retail Client

─ Led implementation of features within the "Discover" module, including item sort/filter and camera search, while integrating AR-related functionalities.
─ Served as the resident SwiftUI expert, providing guidance and support to junior developers.
─ Enhanced code quality by conducting thorough code reviews and refactoring existing code from Objective-C to Swift/SwiftUI.

Publicis Groupe (Marcel)

─ Implemented a micro-service based application architecture using CocoaPods. 
─ Developed a server-driven UI template system using Swift/SwiftUI.
─ Designed a secure network layer using certificate pinning to ensure data protection.
─ Led knowledge transfer sessions to onboard new developers and maintain code quality through reviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer L1
positions.description:
Global QSR [Quick Service Restaurant] Client

─ Maintained application integrity, resolved critical logic issues, and set up version control workflows.
─ Implemented in-app debugging logic to streamline development and issue resolution.
─ Provided technical support during the sunset phase of the older application version.

Regional QSR Client

─ Rebuilt the self-service mobile application, focusing on user-friendly transaction logic and product customization.
─ Established and managed Continuous Integration processes using Jenkins and Fastlane for efficient development workflows.
─ Acted as a technical consultant during project planning, ensuring feasibility and alignment with business goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
FC Research

─ Implemented customizable features for the Fulfillment Center's internal web-service, focusing on improving employee efficiency.
─ Developed personalized settings logic using JavaScript/JSP and Java.
─ Presented new settings capabilities in a keynote presentation, showcasing improvements to internal tools.
